This application under Section 439 Cr.P.C, is preferred by the petitioner, namely, Rofikur Page No.# 2/2 Rohman who is in judicial custody since 27.02.2023 in connection with Special (POCSO)
Case No. 14/2023, registered under Section 376 (DA) IPC and R/W Section 6 of POCSO Act (arising out of Bogijan Police Station Case No. 03/2023) pending before the Court of Special Judge, POCSO at Golaghat.
3.

entities.text: Court of Special Judge, POCSO at Golaghat
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. B.B. Gogoi, learned Addl. PP who has raised objection against the bail petition.
4. The FIR unfolds that on 15.02.2023, the victim 'X' went to watch theatre at Bogijan.
As she went out of the theatre, taking advantage of the darkness some miscreants stopped her and committed rape on her.
The present petitioner was named in the FIR.
It is submitted that the present petitioner was not incriminated in her statement u/s 164 Cr.PC, made by the victim.
5. Notice was issued to the respondent No. 2, who has received the notice but is not represented today.
6. I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection.
The evidence of the victim has already been recorded by the trial Court.
The petitioner was behind bars for 10 months.
The petitioner has pledged to co-operate with the trial.
The petitioner has submitted that he is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
7. I have also considered the submission that the petitioner is a local resident.
8. Considering all aspects and in view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.

The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge (POCSO), Golaghat under the conditions that:-
i] the petitioner shall not go near the vicinity of the victim; and ii] the petitioner shall not exercise threats to the witnesses and tamper with the evidence.
On breach of any of the bail conditions, bail order shall stand cancelled.

Accordingly,
bail application stands disposed of.
